How a consultation works

Three steps, in this order — deliberately. Price comes after the surgeon has seen you, not before.

1

Book a consultation

Book through HotDoc, or call (02) 4001 0511. Tell the team which procedure you are considering — eyelid surgery or breast augmentation — so the right appointment is booked.

2

Meet Dr Sanjay Verma

Dr Verma has 36+ years of experience. The consultation is where suitability, options and expectations are discussed — in person, in private.

3

Receive your personal quote

Only after consultation do you receive a quote for your procedure. The guide prices on this page — eyelid surgery from $4,950*, breast augmentation from $9,900* — are starting points, not your price. *Guide price, quote after consultation.

Dr Sanjay Verma

36+ years of experience.

That number is the reason this page leads with consultation rather than price. Experience does not make a procedure right for everyone — the consultation is what establishes whether it is right for you.
